title: seilbahn.toml
description: The config file used everywhere to declare packages and artifacts for deployment

schema-version.description: Version of this contract. Bumped when seilbahn makes a breaking change to the file format.

defaults.description: Values inherited by every package that does not set them itself.

packages.description: Every versioned, releasable unit in the repo. A package with no artifacts is a library: still change-detected, tagged and tested, but nothing is published from it.

allOf.$comment: `runtime` is required per package unless [defaults] supplies one.

additionalProperties.$comment: no `runtime` and no [defaults] runtime to fall back on

packageName.description: Letters, digits, underscores and hyphens; must not start with a hyphen. Dots are reserved for artifact identity separators.

artifactName.description: Letters, digits, underscores and hyphens; must not start with a hyphen. Dots are reserved for artifact identity separators.

runtime.description: Selects which manifest the package version is read from: python -> pyproject.toml (project.version), rust -> Cargo.toml (package.version), node -> package.json (version).

artifactType.description: docker publishes an image to ECR; lambda publishes a zip to S3.

path.description: Repo-relative package directory. "." for a single-package repo.

test.description: Whether the package will be run through test workflow.

test-id.description: Argument passed to `mise run test-ci <id>`. Defaults to the package name.

artifacts.description: Package-scoped artifacts. Repository, package, artifact and type identify the manifest entry, renaming either package or artifact changes its identity.

type.description: One flavor, or a list of both - the same artifact name published as an image *and* a zip under one manifest key.

dockerfile.description: docker only. Package-relative, the build context is always the repo root.

target.description: docker only. Named multi-stage target. Omitted builds the final stage.

build.description: lambda only, required. Shell command that fills `output-dir`. Runs under mise from the repo root.

output-dir.description: lambda only. Repo-root-relative directory the `build` command populates. Defaults to dist/<artifact>.

extra-files.description: lambda only. Package-relative paths copied into the zip, preserving their relative layout.

allOf.$comment: docker-only keys are invalid on an artifact that does not publish an image
every lambda declares how its zip is filled - there is no built-in recipe - and the zip keys are invalid on an artifact that does not publish one
